title: Petra and the Provision
author: Odile Underhill
blurb: Elodie Ashgrove, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the dry season ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
